caption: The list of join keys travels from B to A in 2 KB; the reduced relation R′ of 10,000 tuples (1 MB) comes back to B, where the final join with the 500 tuples of S runs. Shipping all of R instead would cost 10 MB.

spec.aria: A query plan tree where a 2 KB list of sid values goes from site B to site A, the reduced relation R′ of 1 MB comes back to B, and the final join with S runs at B.
